lines.text: In sight of the whole congregation, Joshua removed Aaron's garments, and Aaron died there on top of the mountain.

problems.problem: Its true detail "on top of Mount Hor" isn't in Numbers 20:28 word for word.
Its wrong detail "on top of Mount Sinai" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
